basic_info.main_problem: 与饮食相关的内疚与自我批评(尤其是吃披萨).自本学期加入大学田径队后在学业与训练压力下被trigger并逐渐加重,几乎每天出现,After training或'cheat day'尤甚.尝试通过限制饮食与增加运动来应对但not yet能缓解负性想法.
basic_info.core_demands: 寻求支持以应对这些not健康的思维模式,减轻Self-blame and guilt,改善自尊与整体幸福感.
growth_experiences: 进入大学成为大一新生并加入校田径队,需要在学业与训练之间平衡;由此将披萨等食物与'not自律/影响表现'联系起来,进食后频繁出现Intense guilt and self-criticism(几乎每日,After training或'cheat day'更明显);曾尝试以严格限制饮食与增加运动作为补偿,但负性思维not yet见好转.

core_beliefs: 只有保持完美的自律与控制,我才是有价值/合格的(尤其作为Athlete).
吃像披萨这样的'放纵'食物意味着我失败,not配做一名合格的Athlete.

special_situations.event: After training ends or on a 'cheat day', eats pizza with classmates
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 作为Athlete必须始终严格自律,只吃'健康'食物;一旦放松饮食就会影响表现与进展
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Strictly restricts diet and increases exercise to compensate; maintains 'discipline' through self-reproach
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我not应该吃这个;I will ruin all progress.

special_situations.event: When thinking about or planning to eat pizza
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 一次'not健康'饮食会毁掉此前所有训练与营养管理的成果
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 通过加练,更加严格地控制饮食来Undoing'损失'

special_situations.event: 吃完披萨后回想自己的选择和身份(作为Athlete)
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 要么完全自律,要么就是失败者;not允许有灰色地带或适度享用
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 用'应该/必须'的规则化自我Demands来Reinforcement绝对化标准,避免再次放松
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 一次吃披萨就说明我not自律/我是个失败的Athlete.

special_situations.event: Thinking about confiding these thoughts to friends or teammates
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 表达困扰会被视为软弱或给他人添麻烦;他人not会理解我
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Chooses silence and self-isolation, avoids discussing with others
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们not会理解,我not该麻烦do not人.

core_conflict.wish: 渴望既被认可为合格的Athlete,又能自在享受饮食与生活而not被指责
core_conflict.fear: 害怕一旦放松自我就会失败,被评判或not被接纳,进而失去价值与归属
defense_goal: Maintains safety and control through self-reproach and strict self-discipline
避免表达需要与求助以躲避Being rejected/被误解
以高标准Repression享乐冲动以减少羞耻与Anxiety

object_relations.self_representation: not够自律,需要通过完美表现证明自己的Athlete/Student
object_relations.object_representation: 苛刻的评判者(队友,室友或他人),not会理解,可能失望的人

object_relations.self_representation: A burden who may trouble others
object_relations.object_representation: Others who would be dragged down by me or forced to comfort me

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When asked or thinking about discussing diet-related distress and emotions with friends/teammates
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 表达会成为do not人的负担,得not到理解(移情:将他人视为评判者)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Expresses in a tone of self-blame and lowered self-worth, avoiding raising concrete requests or seeking help, downplaying her own needs in her words.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当谈到'Athlete的饮食纪律/吃披萨是否允许'等价值判断时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Worries emotional expression will be seen as weakness, so emphasizes rules and rational standards instead
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: use规则化与抽象化表述(如'应该/必须'),语气克制,回避情绪词汇与主观感受.

manifestations: 以'应该/必须'的外在标准约束自我选择,认为作为Athletenot能吃披萨
Lacks flexibility in eating; fears relaxing self-control
outcomes: Interference with daily life (sleep, training rhythm)

manifestations: 担心'他们not会理解',避免与朋友和队友沟通

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: 频繁use'应该/必须'的句式(如'作为Athlete我应该更自律')
将'吃披萨=not自律/失败'作为硬性标准对待自己

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves.
manifestations: 常说'我not该麻烦do not人',把表达与求助的冲动收回到自己身上
When emotionally distressed, chooses self-isolation rather than seeking support

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'.
manifestations: 预设他人not会理解或会被自己拖累,因此not去沟通
Attributes potential evaluation and blame to others' perspective to avoid self-expression

exception_events.target_problem: 在吃披萨或'cheat day'后,来访者通常会产生Strong guilt并认为会毁掉训练与营养管理的进展,随后自责并Avoids socializing.
exception_events.unique_outcome: 来访者注意到并非每次吃披萨后表现都会变差;在这些情况下,担心的'表现下降'have not出现,Sense of guilt也比Anticipation更可控.
exception_events.reason: 线索:观察到客观表现与担忧并not总一致;实际训练状态,休息与整体饮食结构可能起到缓冲作用,从而削弱了'一次放纵=全盘皆输'的信念.

positive_force: Willing to seek professional help, positive attitude
具备自我Reflection与认知重构的能力(能够提出'这一餐not会定义我的进展'等替代想法)
Has certain social support resources (friends and teammates)
Strong sense of purpose and self-discipline (continuously participates in learning and training)
negative_force: 自我苛责,倾向将压力Turning against the self
Worries about being misunderstood and avoids communication, leading to social isolation
Uses dietary restriction and excessive exercise as a fixed compensatory strategy, maintaining the negative cycle

target_behavior.consequence: Impaired self-esteem,睡眠与锻炼节律受影响,Declining academic performance
